title: 3D loose guns: Mk58, Lecter and their magazines
scope: Art only: source-faithful 3D held/dropped Mk58 and Lecter, their source-visible magazine states, MagazinePistol and MagazineRifle; no gameplay code or unrelated weapons.
target_runtime: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.224: existing ItemRenderer baked-item and loose block_model/NONE route, neoforge:obj + MTL #atlas + atlas PNG + complete item wrappers; not wearable interchange or sprite-only models.
dependencies: Use the frozen MODEL-BRIEF.md and MODEL-SAMPLES.md contracts and pinned SS14 entity/RSI references.
Independent of the manual-feed and energy requests; do not duplicate their assets.
Gameplay and any new appearance predicates/anchor consumers are implemented by the coding author, not the modeler.
brief: Create true volumetric 3D models for WeaponPistolMk58, WeaponRifleLecter, MagazinePistol and MagazineRifle. Follow the pinned silhouettes/palettes and actual source layers; include assembled and magazine-absent gun appearances, separate magazine models and source-visible fullness mapping. No flat sprites, sprite-on-box proxies, generic block guns or code-generated placeholders. Deliver complete supported native OBJ/MTL/#atlas PNG/item-wrapper groups, authored held transforms for both hands and documented raw NONE-context world placement. Include editable projects, grip/muzzle/insertion alignment documentation, source comparison, six views, atlas and actual held/dropped review images. Preserve per-file provenance/license. Read the attached brief for exact canonical paths, runtime limitations, state and review requirements. Delivery is not acceptance/import.
